steps: Actual GUI plan/build/run yields protocol 10 initial, event #2, completion #1 and direct entries. Event #1 fails the v5 combined guard without an entry. The review displays payload 3 and the completed Strike clip, distinct from the newly selected Idle clip; later command receipts remain separate.

Keyboard previous/next/select preserve entry identity. A selected completion remains reviewable when the flat list filter hides every row. Chinese, English and Japanese retain its source, selection and focused control at 390px without horizontal overflow.

Closing a review does not alter the recorded run. Reopening the selected controller and both review source buttons navigate to frozen binding and author-script locations through the guarded editor. Build/run, pinned review, filtering, language changes and source navigation leave every author file unchanged.
